name: Neck Skin Consistency
algorithm: Neck Skin Consistency — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes video frames for deepfake and AI generation detection:

1. **Frame Extraction**: Key frames are extracted from the video stream for analysis.

2. **Feature Analysis**: Analyzes neck skin textoure consistency. Relevant visual and temporal features are computed per frame.

3. **Temporal Consistency Check**: Features are tracked across consecutive frames to detect inconsistencies.

4. **Pattern Matching**: Results are compared against known deepfake artifact patterns.

5. **Cálculo de puntuación**: A confidence score (0-100) reflecting the likelihood of AI manipulation is calculated.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated video through neck skin consistency analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for video authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard video formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other video forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by video compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic video
